module.purpose: Embeds computed DOM styles, pseudo-element styles, fonts, and referenced resources so serialized HTML or SVG preserves rendered appearance.
module.summary: This module snapshots styles from a root element and its rendered descendants, omitting defaults and inherited values where appropriate. It supports computed-style APIs with a browser-compatible fallback, serializes pseudo-elements into generated CSS classes, embeds external CSS resources as data URLs, tracks font usage, unwraps shadow DOM custom elements, and manages an isolated iframe used to calculate browser defaults.
module.businessContext: The editor exports rendered documents while preserving visual fidelity across environments. Failures can produce missing fonts, external assets, shadow-DOM content, or styling differences in exported output.

moduleContractTests.then: The returned CSS contains embedded pseudo-element rules and each element contains its applicable non-default style declarations.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards root-style inclusion and descendant style serialization.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A child has only styles equal to browser defaults or already inherited from an ancestor.
moduleContractTests.then: The child output does not redundantly serialize those default or inherited properties.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves compact output while retaining effective visual styles.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Captured styles contain CSS URLs and font-family values.
moduleContractTests.then: Resolvable CSS URLs are replaced with data URLs and font-family values are registered with the font embedder.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards self-contained export behavior for external style resources.

moduleContractTests.then: The returned CSS contains a generated class selector targeting the corresponding pseudo-element.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures pseudo-element content and styles survive serialization.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A captured custom element has a shadow root containing rendered elements and text.
moduleContractTests.then: Shadow-root contents are placed inside a data-tl-custom-element wrapper and the original custom element is removed.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards preservation of shadow DOM content in ordinary DOM serialization.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Styles reference one or more font families whose resources have been processed.
moduleContractTests.then: The returned string contains the font-face CSS generated for the registered fonts.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the public font embedding output used by the export pipeline.

units.name: StyleEmbedder

detail.name: StyleEmbedder
detail.summary: StyleEmbedder collects computed styles and pseudo-element styles for a DOM subtree, embeds referenced resources, handles custom-element shadow content, and produces serialized CSS suitable for export.

units.name: readRootElementStyles

detail.name: readRootElementStyles
preconditions: rootElement is an Element representing the root of the subtree to inspect.
postconditions: Styles for the root element are read without respecting default-style suppression.
Rendered descendants of the root element are traversed and their styles are read with default and inherited-style suppression.
The resulting style information is recorded by the StyleEmbedder.
invariants: Only rendered descendants returned by getRenderedChildren are traversed.
The root element is processed before its descendants.
Descendant traversal continues recursively through each rendered child's rendered children.
edgeCases: A root element with no rendered children is processed once and traversal terminates.
Nested rendered descendants are discovered and processed during traversal.
Styles matching an element's defaults are retained for the root but may be omitted for descendants.
stateMutations: Updates the StyleEmbedder style records through readElementStyles.
detail.summary: Reads and records style information for a root element and its rendered descendants. Root styles are fully applied, while descendant styles avoid redundant defaults and inherited parent styles.

units.name: readElementStyles

detail.name: readElementStyles
preconditions: element is an Element with an ownerDocument.
this.styles is available for ancestor-style lookup.
postconditions: When shouldRespectDefaults is true, tag-default styles are obtained for the element's lowercased tag name.
When shouldSkipInheritedParentStyles is true, ancestor styles are considered from the element's parent upward.
For each inherited style property, the nearest ancestor value takes precedence over more distant ancestor values.
invariants: Ancestor traversal proceeds through parentElement links until no ancestor remains.
An inherited property is added to parentStyles only when it has not already been populated.
edgeCases: When shouldRespectDefaults is false, the default-style lookup is skipped and NO_STYLES is used.
When shouldSkipInheritedParentStyles is false, ancestor traversal and inherited-parent style collection are skipped.
When the element has no parentElement, no inherited parent styles are collected.
When multiple ancestors define the same style property, the closest ancestor encountered first supplies the retained value.
detail.summary: Reads style information for an element, optionally incorporating tag-default styles and inherited styles from ancestor elements.

units.name: fetchResources

detail.name: fetchResources
preconditions: The StyleEmbedder instance has a styles collection whose values contain element style information or are safely iterable by objectMapValues.
postconditions: Every non-empty style property value is examined for CSS URLs.
Every non-empty font-family property is passed to the font resource handler.
Discovered CSS URL matches are scheduled for asynchronous resource processing.
invariants: Empty or falsy style objects are skipped.
Empty or falsy property values do not trigger font handling or URL parsing.
Properties other than font-family are not passed to the font-family handler.
edgeCases: An empty styles collection results in no scheduled work.
A missing or falsy style object is skipped.
A falsy property value is skipped.
A style value without CSS URLs schedules no URL-processing task.
A style value containing multiple CSS URLs schedules one asynchronous task per parsed URL match.
A font-family value is handled before its value is parsed for URLs.
stateMutations: The font resource handler may update its internal state when given a font-family value.
Asynchronous resource-processing tasks may update the StyleEmbedder's resource-related state.
detail.summary: Scans collected element and pseudo-element styles for font-family values and CSS URLs, initiating the corresponding resource-processing work.

units.name: unwrapCustomElements

detail.name: unwrapCustomElements
preconditions: The StyleEmbedder instance has an initialized styles mapping.
Elements being processed belong to an owner document and have a parent element when a shadow-root container must be inserted without a cloned parent.
postconditions: Each visited custom element with a shadow root is replaced by a div container marked with its original tag name.
The generated container inherits the style mapping entry of the corresponding original element.
Shadow-root element children are recursively represented beneath the generated container, and non-element shadow-root children are deeply cloned.
Original elements with shadow roots are removed from the document.
Style elements encountered while cloning into a custom-element container are not cloned.
invariants: A DOM node is processed at most once during the traversal.
The data-tl-custom-element attribute value is the original custom element's tagName.
Style mappings for cloned or generated elements are copied from the corresponding source element.
edgeCases: An already visited element is ignored without further mutation.
An element without a shadow root is shallow-cloned into the active cloned parent and processed according to the traversal logic.
A style element encountered under a cloned custom-element parent is skipped rather than cloned.
Non-element shadow-root children are deeply cloned and appended without recursive element processing.
A shadow-root custom element at the root of the traversal uses its original parent element as the insertion parent when no cloned parent is supplied.
stateMutations: Mutates the DOM by appending generated or cloned nodes and removing original custom elements.
Mutates this.styles by adding entries for generated and cloned elements.
detail.summary: Unwraps custom elements by moving their shadow-DOM contents into cloned light-DOM containers while preserving the associated styles. It removes the original custom elements and avoids revisiting nodes.

specLiterals.role: Attribute marking generated containers for unwrapped custom elements.
HTML element type used for generated custom-element containers.
Tag name whose elements are excluded from cloning inside custom-element containers.

specTests.then: The original custom element is removed; a div with data-tl-custom-element="MY-CARD" is appended in its place, its styles entry matches the original, and the shadow-root children are represented inside it.
The style element is not cloned into the generated container, while the other shadow-root content is processed.
Only the first encounter mutates or clones it; subsequent encounters are ignored.

units.name: embedStyles

detail.name: embedStyles
preconditions: The embedder has been initialized with its collected element styles.
postconditions: Returns a CSS string containing rules for every collected before or after pseudo-element style.
Each element with a before or after style has a generated pseudo class added to its class list.
For each affected element, the ::before rule precedes the ::after rule when both are present.
invariants: CSS rules are emitted in the iteration order of the collected styles.
Elements without before or after styles do not receive a generated pseudo class and emit no rule.
edgeCases: When no collected element has before or after styles, returns an empty string and adds no classes.
When an element has only a before style, emits one ::before rule.
When an element has only an after style, emits one ::after rule.
When an element has both styles, emits two rules using the same generated class, with ::before before ::after.
stateMutations: Adds a generated class name to each collected element that has a before or after style.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns CSS text. Each generated pseudo-element rule has the form .<generated-class>::before {<formatted-style>}\n or .<generated-class>::after {<formatted-style>}\n. If both rules exist for one element, the ::before rule is emitted first.
detail.summary: Generates CSS rules embedding the collected ::before and ::after styles. Elements with pseudo-element styles receive generated class names used by the emitted selectors.

specLiterals.role: CSS serialization shape for an element's ::before style.
CSS serialization shape for an element's ::after style.

specTests.then: The element receives one generated pseudo class and the returned CSS contains one ::before rule for that class, terminated by a newline.
The element receives one generated pseudo class and the returned CSS contains the ::before rule followed by the ::after rule for that class.
The method returns an empty string and does not add generated pseudo classes.

units.name: styleFromElement

detail.name: styleFromElement
detail.summary: Derives a style representation from an element for use by the style-embedding pipeline.

units.name: styleFromPseudoElement

detail.name: styleFromPseudoElement
detail.summary: Derives the style representation associated with an element's pseudo-element for style embedding.

units.name: styleFromComputedStyleMap

detail.name: styleFromComputedStyleMap
preconditions: The style argument is a readable computed style property map.
defaultStyles and parentStyles provide the style context expected by the conversion.
postconditions: Returns the style representation derived from the computed property map and supplied style context.
invariants: The conversion is based on the supplied computed style map and style context without mutating them.
edgeCases: Properties whose computed values match default or inherited parent values are handled according to the supplied defaultStyles and parentStyles context.
An empty or property-sparse style map produces the corresponding style representation without introducing unspecified properties.
detail.summary: Converts a computed CSS property map into the exported style representation, using default and parent style information to determine the resulting values.

units.name: styleFromComputedStyle

detail.name: styleFromComputedStyle
preconditions: The supplied style source supports property lookup and iteration.
The supplied default-style and parent-style records, when used by property rules, are available.
postconditions: Returns a record of included CSS properties and their string values.
Properties excluded by the CSS-property filter, equal to their default value, or rejected by their property rule are absent from the result.
invariants: Every returned property is accepted by the CSS-property inclusion predicate.
No returned property has the same value as the corresponding default style.
Returned property values are string representations of the source style values.
edgeCases: A missing color value produces an empty current-color value for rule evaluation.
A property with no source value is not emitted when its rule or inclusion logic excludes it.
A property whose value equals the corresponding default style is omitted.
A property without a custom rule is retained when it passes inclusion and differs from its default.
detail.summary: Converts computed style information into a CSS property-to-value record containing only relevant, non-default styles that pass the applicable property rules.

specLiterals.role: Fallback value used when the computed color or a requested property has no value.

units.name: formatCss

detail.name: formatCss
detail.summary: Formats style data as CSS for use in the style-embedding export flow.

units.name: getDefaultStyleFrame

detail.name: getDefaultStyleFrame
preconditions: A browser-like document context is available.
postconditions: Returns the default-style frame used by the style embedding helpers.
The returned frame is available for subsequent default-style lookups.
invariants: Repeated calls reuse the existing default-style frame until it is destroyed.
edgeCases: First call creates and registers the default-style frame before returning it.
Subsequent calls return the already-created frame without creating another frame.

raises: Underlying DOM errors from frame creation or registration

stateMutations: Lazily initializes the module-level default-style frame reference.
Adds the frame to the document used for style computation on first initialization.
detail.summary: Provides the document frame used as an isolated context for determining default element styles. The frame is reused while available so repeated style lookups share the same context.

specTests.then: A frame is created, registered in the document, and returned.
The previously initialized frame is returned and no additional frame is created.

units.name: destroyDefaultStyleFrame

detail.name: destroyDefaultStyleFrame
postconditions: The stored default-style frame reference is cleared after destruction.
The associated iframe is removed from the document when a default-style frame exists.
invariants: At most one stored default-style frame reference remains after the function returns.
edgeCases: When no default-style frame has been created, the function is a no-op.
When a default-style frame exists, its iframe is removed and the cached frame state is cleared.
stateMutations: The module-level defaultStyleFrame reference is cleared.
The DOM is mutated by removing the default-style iframe when present.
detail.summary: Destroys the shared default-style iframe when one has been created and clears its stored reference. If no default-style frame exists, the function performs no observable action.

units.name: getDefaultStylesForTagName

detail.name: getDefaultStylesForTagName
preconditions: The supplied tag name is usable to create or resolve an HTML element in the relevant document context.
postconditions: Returns the default style representation associated with the requested tag name without changing the caller's document content permanently.
invariants: Default styles are derived from the browser's default styling behavior rather than caller-provided styles.
edgeCases: A tag name with no distinctive browser default styling yields the corresponding neutral or inherited default style representation.
An unsupported or invalid tag name follows the underlying document or element-creation behavior.
detail.summary: Retrieves the default styles associated with a specified HTML tag name, using the browser's style environment as the source of truth.
